_note: Schedules fire as soon as enabled and a stopped agent skips firings. For the demo, create with a far-future cron so it never fires on its own, and trigger the same message manually. Delete schedules before deleting the agent. Use five-field cron plus tz.

payload.message: Run the daily disposition review. Today is {{TODAY}}. Pickup lead time is 7 days. Review all inventory, route due items, book pickups, send alerts, and finish with the summary.

rubric: Every item that is due according to the disposition rules was routed or escalated; none were silently dropped.
No item that is held, not due, or already alerted appears in a pickup or alert.
No pickup mixes recycle_mixed items into shred, mixes colour groups in a shred lot, or falls below the partner's minimum.
Each booked pickup has exactly one donate_recycle_due alert, and each escalation has exactly one review_waiting alert.
The final summary lists counts and a reason for each skipped or escalated group.
